title: Pull the Firewood from Under the Pot
era: Late Eastern Han · about 1,800 years ago

source.chapter: Pull the Firewood from Under the Pot
source.quote: When you cannot match his strength, dissolve what gives him force: the lake below, the sky above.

moral: Do not fight the fire head-on: pull the firewood out from under it, one log at a time.
transfer: Find what really causes the mess, then fix that.
